verdict.line: You lose if Volibear's Q (Thundering Smash) stun chains into his empowered W (Frenzied Maul) before you have E online; you win if you reach your forged tank items and outscale him through mid-to-late game.

brief.thesis: Volibear's kit is built for immediate all-in pressure — a point-and-click stun into a double-cast W that heals him — while Ornn's Q/W/E are control tools that only start winning trades once Living Forge has put armor in his pockets. The 51.4% win rate over 1343 games reflects exactly that: Volibear owns the early lane and solo-kill race, but Ornn's defensive itemization closes the gap to a near coinflip by the time both ultimates are online.

theirWindow.what: The stun chains directly into W (Frenzied Maul) and a passive attack-speed proc; expect him to follow up immediately, and from level 6 on watch your HP bar closely since his R (Stormbringer) can leap in and extend the trade under your own turret.

yourWindow.when: when he whiffs or burns Q (Thundering Smash)
yourWindow.what: With no stun up for 10-12 seconds, charge E (Searing Charge) into nearby terrain for the shockwave knockup, then land Q (Volcanic Rupture) for the slow and free autos — he has no tool to interrupt you in that window.

start.why: Its passive block reduces the flat damage from Volibear's autos and W (Frenzied Maul) procs, which is exactly how he wants to start trades on you.

boots.why: Measured at 54.4% over 717 games, and the tenacity directly shortens how long his Q (Thundering Smash) stun locks you down in his all-in window.

core.why: Builds early so Living Forge lets you craft it mid-wave without a back, and its burn punishes him for staying in auto range.
Grievous Wounds shuts off the heal from his W (Frenzied Maul) second cast, which is the main sustain keeping him ahead in extended trades.
This path hit 65.2% over 46 games; the stacking resistances scale through the mixed physical/magic damage his passive and R add later.

situational.when: he starts building lifesteal or on-hit items to out-sustain your trades
their jungler or mid is stacking magic damage on top of his passive's bonus magic autos
he rushes attack speed and is trying to proc his passive and W marks faster than you can punish

runes.keystoneWhy: Sustained healing from autoing him back punishes his auto-reliant W (Frenzied Maul) trading pattern and keeps you even on HP through his all-in window.

summoners.why: Teleport is run in 74.2% of games at a matching 51.4% win rate; it lets you reset after his forced all-ins and turret dives instead of fighting on his terms.

playing.title: Don't trade before level 3
playing.detail: Until you have two abilities up, you can't answer his Q (Thundering Smash) stun with a knockup of your own — just last-hit and wait.

playing.title: All-in only on his cooldowns
playing.detail: Thundering Smash is 12-10s and Frenzied Maul is a flat 5s; if he's already used both, charge E (Searing Charge) into terrain and follow with Q (Volcanic Rupture).

playing.title: Respect his level 6 dive
playing.detail: Stormbringer disables nearby towers on landing, so don't sit at low HP near your turret from level 6 on — OP.GG's own data flags this as the main death pattern.

playing.title: Forge boots and armor on the wave
playing.detail: Living Forge lets you craft Mercury's Treads or Thornmail pieces without recalling, so buy the moment you hit the gold threshold instead of waiting for a back.

playing.title: Apply Brittle before engaging
playing.detail: Land W (Bellows Breath) for the Brittle debuff before you commit E (Searing Charge), so your knockup trade also sets up bonus damage on the follow-up Q.

playing.title: Hold the wave pre-6
playing.detail: With 74% of Ornns on Teleport, don't crash the wave for a fast recall-TP reset that lets him freeze you out of XP.

playing.title: Target his heal on cooldown
playing.detail: Thornmail's Grievous Wounds removes the sustain from his second W (Frenzied Maul) cast, so prioritize it the moment his damage output starts outpacing your trades.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, boots, runes, summoners, and all win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning — cooldown windows, ability interactions, and when to engage — is my own tactical read, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Manage your health well during early game as Volibear can use (R) afterwards to dive under turret.
